updateNotes:
The new AniFlow (1.9.1) is a separate app and can't update this one in place.

Get it from github.com/anshsingh70007-hash/AniFinal/releases, install it, then uninstall this old version. Your watchlist and history stay in the old app; they don't carry over.

From 1.9.0 on, updates install straight from the app.
